column2: [intro]
Start a novel, filled with excitement
Characters come alive, take shape in my vision
But soon I drift, lose concentration
Words blur, losing me in confusion
I never finish books
My attention strays, my mind wanders
Pages close before I set them free
The endings escape, I’m a mystery
Plots multiply, emotions cascade
But alas, a distraction and they fade
I promise to return, finish by tomorrow
But tomorrow comes, and books remain in sorrow
I never finish books
My attention strays, my mind wanders
Pages close before I set them free
The endings escape, I’m a mystery
[ solo ]
So here I am, with my collection incomplete
Unfinished books, secrets in a heap
For in my mind, each page awaits its turn
But for now, I’m lost in the imagined world
